minutes_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  April 27, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza
  •  Absent: Ankit Udani
  •  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 121 West Main Street

Recommended Action: 1. The maximum height for Sign Type A shall be reduced by at least 15%;
2. Sign Type B shall be a blade sign using routed metal with push through letters or acrylic backing;
3. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.
The applicant: Tom Humphries was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Applicant for item number one stated that he provided revised drawings per staff comments. Staff
showed the drawings that addressed staff concerns. The applicant gave a brief presentation and
acknowledged the assistance from the City.
Board discussion began on the item and issues included size, sign type and documentation. It was
clarified that the detail shown of the sign was a front lit channel letter with no metal background.
The street elevation shows a grey rectangle which the applicant stated may or may not be present
but that the proposed sign does not include a metal background.

Hernandez - stated that the new dimensions were not shown accurately in the specifications and
should be corrected. She also questioned confirmed tenants. The applicant stated that Boiling Crab
was the main tenant and that the second tenant has not been established.

Espinoza had no comments.

Chiu questioned the parameters of the blade sign as the documentation was misleading. It was
discussed that all materials should be consistent and show design intention and not just maximums
allowed by code.

  1
 Espinoza moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The maximum height shall be shown as 27” maximum thought the documents.
  2. Blade signs shall use routed letters with either push through acrylic or acrylic backing
  3. All final documentation shall be reviewed by DRB staff prior to permits

Hernandez seconded the motion.
The motion was approved unanimously.

MOTION:
 •  Espinoza moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The maximum height shall be shown as 27” maximum thought the documents.
  2. Blade signs shall use routed letters with either push through acrylic or acrylic backing
  3. All final documentation shall be reviewed by DRB staff prior to permits
 •  The second was by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 749 South Sierra Vista Avenue
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO compliant
documents shall be provided at the time of building plan check.

The applicant: Kamen Lai was present for Item number 2 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Applicant for item number one gave a brief presentation and acknowledged the staff comments.

Board discussion began on the item.

Hernandez - questioned the use of solar panels for new projects and how they would affect the front
elevation. Discussion ensued and it was determined that the issue was not significant enough to
warrant further study.

Espinoza - questioned the building finish which was confirmed as smooth stucco

Chiu - questioned the window recess which was confirmed at 2”. Also suggested (not a condition)
further detail at the shutters. The applicant stated he was amenable and could work with staff. Chiu
stated that there were potted plants on the north side and that the species is not appropriate for pots
(they are ground cover not vertical planting.)
Espinoza moved to approve the application with the condition that the applicant shall work with
staff on further detail on the shutters
  2
 Hernandez seconded the motion and the motion was approved unanimously.

MOTION:
Espinoza moved to approve the application with the condition that the applicant shall work with
staff on further detail on the shutters
  •  The second was by Hernandez
  •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
Espinoza moved to adjourn at 8:30, Hernandez seconds and the motion carries unanimously
  •  Espinoza moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30
  •  Seconded by Hernandez
  •  The motion carried unanimously

Ayes: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
